_comment: Undertale collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed undertale-determination` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_undertale.py.

readme.title: Undertale
readme.summary: Pokemon in the monochrome style of an underground RPG, each carrying a human SOUL (inspired by Undertale; original art).
looks: each line carries one SOUL: red determination with save-point sparkles (Litten, Cyndaquil, Chansey); orange bravery (Corsola, Applin, Patrat); yellow justice stars (Sentret, Yanma, Smeargle); green kindness heals (Lotad, Lechonk, Shellos); cyan patience bands (Pyukumuku, Shellder, Glastrier); blue integrity diamonds (Woobat, Duskull, Blipbug)
dithered black, grey and white bodies with a white battle-box outline, white eyes, and a SOUL heart on the chest that glows and beats in the dark
shiny: the SOUL colours turned round the colour wheel
